definition.denominator: 9 * number of valid free faces; C excluded
definition.E: sum squared residual error / free scalar count
definition.B: sum squared teacher effective residual / free scalar count
definition.R: E/B; identity R=1 only when B>1e-14
definition.pooling: pooled E and B use all free scalars; pooled R=sum error SSE/sum teacher energy, subject to the same pooled B low-signal rule
definition.vector_cosine: one flattened free residual vector; NA for low teacher signal or zero student energy
definition.corner_distance: Euclidean norm of each free corner displacement, quantiles over corners
definition.synthetic_target: same-shape diagnostic only, FP64 difference of saved FP32 proposal and target; never real DEV reconstruction
